title: AccessRequest
description: Sent by the Portal to a hospital node's /api/access/requests endpoint, and returned by the node's request-status/list endpoints. Both requester tiers are limited to 'deidentified' data — see architecture.md 'Requester Model'.

request_id.description: Assigned by the node on creation; absent on the initial POST body.

status.description: Lifecycle state per architecture.md's decentralized access-request state diagram. Assigned/owned by the node; absent on the initial POST body.

requester_name.description: Self-declared requester name or demo user identifier.

organization_name.description: Self-declared organization name, always shown to the hospital reviewer.

requester_tier.description: One of the two demo tiers. Both are limited to requested_data_level='deidentified'.

query_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the discovery query that led to this request.

requested_node_id.description: The specific hospital node this request is addressed to.

requested_data_level.description: Fixed to 'deidentified' for the demo; no tier may request more than this.

decision_note.description: Optional reviewer note attached on approve/deny/more-information.
